answer: Require every agent to lock a stake, tied to its own cipher key, for a full epoch; if peers judge its work copied, the stake is burned. A sybil attacker with 500 fake identities must lock 500 stakes while payouts stay capped per epoch, so cost grows linearly and profit vanishes. Like saffron, a real identity is costly to make and worthless when faked; no tide of rewards repays a flood of forgeries
